recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-15554 source follow-up is needed unless PA later chooses a separate new search parameter for the distinct `:missing` use case discussed in FHIR-37591.
issue_request: FHIR-15554 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient Administration issue asking to fix the Patient deceased search parameter because `Patient.deceased.exists()` incorrectly matched `deceasedBoolean=false`; the accepted intent was to match only `deceasedBoolean=true` or a present death date.
initial_application: Historical commit e4f95ecc3e, labeled `GF#1554 patient deceased search expression`, changed the old Patient spreadsheet expression from `Patient.deceased.exists()` to `Patient.deceased.exists() and Patient.deceased != false`. Commit 33b409a4b6 later moved that already-correct expression into `source/patient/bundle-Patient-search-params.xml` during the new-build-core refactor.
additional_context: Patient is active in `source/fhir.ini`, so the Patient search parameter bundle is current build input. Later issue FHIR-37591 challenged the expression for `:missing` behavior, but PA resolved it Not Persuasive because a fully compatible fix would require deprecating the existing normative search parameter and creating a new one. FHIR-15807 was a duplicate of the same false-boolean complaint, and FHIR-23068 concerned the now-removed XPath form rather than a needed FHIRPath source change.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit and made no source edits because `source/patient/bundle-Patient-search-params.xml` already uses `Patient.deceased.exists() and Patient.deceased != false` for `Patient-deceased`.
